## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /pr/grc/{grcToken}` — Authenticate using a GRC token.

### Data Read (10)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /internal_api/{internal_apiId}` — Retrieve data using an internal API ID.
- `GET /internal_api/chat_rooms/unread_chat_rooms` — Get unread chat rooms.
- `GET /internal_api/chat_threads/unread_chat_threads` — Get unread chat threads.
- `GET /internal_api/email_hub/status` — Check the status of the email hub.
- `GET /internal_api/live_streams/rooms/live_now` — Get currently live stream rooms.
- `GET /internal_api/live_streams/usage/limit_info` — Get live stream usage limit information.
- `GET /internal_api/notifications/new_notifications_count` — Get the count of new notifications.
- `GET /internal_api/spaces/{spaceId}` — Retrieve data for a specific space.
- `GET /internal_api/spaces/{spaceId}/{spaceId}` — Retrieve data for a specific space (duplicate ID).

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /internal_api/spaces/{spaceId}/reset_unread_count` — Reset the unread count for a space.

### Search (3)
- `GET /internal_api/search/community_bot/profiles` — Search for community bot profiles.
- `GET /internal_api/search/community_members` — Search for community members.
- `GET /search/photos` — Search for photos.

### Config (2)
- `GET /internal_api/communities/experimentation/flags` — Get community experimentation flags.
- `GET /internal_api/settings/header_menu_links` — Get header menu links configuration.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /v1/` — Access the core API.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Login Circle So's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Login Circle So data without official API access
- Automate actions on login.circle.so (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Login Circle So frontend uses

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { LoginCircleSoClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
const client = await LoginCircleSoClient.fromAuthFile("auth.json");

// Make requests to internal endpoints
const result = await client.get("/endpoint");
```
